name: Aroha Renata
bio:
Aroha's journey into motorsport was almost accidental. Initially trained as a mechanical engineer, she found herself drawn to the raw energy and constant innovation of racing. After a stint in the merchant navy, she returned home to New Zealand and jumped at the chance to work with a local rally team, honing her skills in fabrication and problem-solving under immense pressure.

Her approach to fabrication is meticulous and uncompromising. Aroha believes in the importance of precision and reliability, ensuring every component she works on meets the highest standards. While she can be demanding, she is also a dedicated mentor, always willing to share her knowledge and guide younger team members. Her experience adapting to rapidly changing environments has made her an invaluable asset to any team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, practical bob with subtle grey streaks.
physical.description: Aroha is a woman of sturdy build, with strong hands that show years of skilled labor.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn copy of an engineering handbook.
Has a habit of whistling old Maori folk songs while working.
Insists on using only Imperial measurements alongside metric, often to the annoyance of others.
